name: open-elevation-step-at-ramp-plate
open: A road drawn at an authored height steps where its ramp meets a junction plate. solveVariable (world/elevation.ts) eases height between the plate edges with a smoothstep whose peak grade is 1.5x its average, caps it with slopeLimit(RAMP_GRADE) without fixed samples, then pinPlates puts the plates back: what the limiter could not absorb returns as a step at the plate edge. The editor checks grade against the chord (commit.ts) and the preview uses a third curve. Fixed by the single vertical-profile solver (plan Lote R, step R2).
